result.summary: Adds one new evidence patch, docs/validation/evidence/movement-component-validation-2026-09-20/author-owner.patch, as a unified diff against godot/scripts/core/movement.gd only. Three hunks: (1) the nine exact REFUSE_COLUMN_* codes (SHAPE/PHASE/RESERVED/REMAINDER/SPEED/VELOCITY/CELL/TARGET/STATE) beside the existing refusal namespace; (2) the narrow _attach_route repair — after the last speed refusal and before _reset_motion, decrement _travelling_count exactly once when that row's current phase is MOTION_TRAVELLING, so every refusal still precedes the adjustment and leaves row and count untouched; (3) an appended cold `class Columns` with the sixteen i32 columns in canonical Schema.FIELD_KEYS[171..186] order (not declaration order), an argument-free _init sizing every column to MOTION_CAPACITY with zero defaults except grid_next/grid_cell at NO_REQUEST, is_sized(), and the static argument-only columns_refusal() plus helpers. The predicate checks shape before any index, then ascending physical rows in the contract's exact per-row priority: phase domain, six reserved columns zero, remainder 0..419, speed zero or a Residents.SIZE_MOVEMENT_U_PER_S member, two-sided velocity bound (speed+29)/30, cell domain NO_REQUEST or 0..CELL_COUNT-1, target pair both zero or both exact cell centres, then phase relations — ARRIVED retains bounded velocity and may hold a zero target, phases 3..5 retain fractions and abandoned target with zero velocity, IDLE retains speed and grid cell. Bounds are read from the existing compiled constants and SpatialWorld's static centre helpers are reused only after the cell-domain gate. No live owner construction, callback, clock read, diagnostic, float, input mutation, per-row allocation or packed scratch; no new public gameplay API, clamp, recount, despawn callback or bulk restore. No bridge, test, doc or full-file content is included, and no execution is claimed. Patch is 266 lines total, within the 450 hard limit and under the 300 aim.

diff --git a/godot/scripts/core/movement.gd b/godot/scripts/core/movement.gd
--- a/godot/scripts/core/movement.gd
+++ b/godot/scripts/core/movement.gd
@@ -269,4 +269,17 @@
 const REFUSE_CONTACT_REVISION: StringName = &"CONTACT_DESTINATION_REVISION_STALE"
 const REFUSE_ROUTE_CONTACT: StringName = &"ROUTE_DOES_NOT_END_AT_CONTACT_APPROACH"
+
+## The nine cold-image refusals of MOVEMENT-S4-VALIDATE-R01, one per gate of `columns_refusal()`.
+## Each names a SAVED-IMAGE domain violation and never a live-admission outcome, so they are a
+## deliberately separate namespace from the REFUSE_* codes above and carry owner 8's exact codes.
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE: StringName = &"COLUMN_SHAPE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_PHASE: StringName = &"COLUMN_PHASE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_RESERVED: StringName = &"COLUMN_RESERVED"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_REMAINDER: StringName = &"COLUMN_REMAINDER"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_SPEED: StringName = &"COLUMN_SPEED"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_VELOCITY: StringName = &"COLUMN_VELOCITY"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_CELL: StringName = &"COLUMN_CELL"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_TARGET: StringName = &"COLUMN_TARGET"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_STATE"
 
 const NO_REQUEST: int = -1
@@ -660,6 +673,11 @@
 	var speed: int = _speed_of(resident)
 	if speed <= 0:
 		_last_refusal = REFUSE_SIZE_CLASS
 		return false
+	# MOVEMENT-S4-VALIDATE-R01: this row may ALREADY be a counted traveller. Re-admission resets
+	# and re-attaches it and increments once below, so its old contribution is removed here --
+	# after every refusal above, so a refused admission still leaves row and count untouched.
+	if _movement_phase[row] == MOTION_TRAVELLING:
+		_travelling_count -= 1
 	_reset_motion(row)
 	_speed_u_per_s[row] = speed
@@ -995,3 +1013,231 @@
 func last_refusal() -> StringName:
 	"""The refusal code from the most recent refusing call, or REFUSE_NONE after a success."""
 	return _last_refusal
+
+
+# --- MOVEMENT-S4-VALIDATE-R01 cold saved-image validation, ADR 0182 ------------------------------
+#
+# THE SIXTEEN COLUMNS BELOW ARE IN CANONICAL SCHEMA ORDER, `Schema.FIELD_KEYS[171..186]`, WHICH IS
+# NOT THIS FILE'S DECLARATION ORDER. The live columns are declared in ARCH-MEM-008's reading order,
+# which puts `_grid_next`/`_grid_cell` ahead of `_radius_u`/`_speed_u_per_s`; owner 8's saved field
+# window does not. Reordering either list to match the other renumbers a persisted field, so both
+# orders stand and the canonical one is named where it is used.
+#
+# VALIDATION IS COLD. No Movement, SpatialWorld, Navigation, Residents, Transforms or Directory
+# instance is built, no callback fires, no clock is read, no diagnostic is emitted, no float
+# appears and no row allocates: the predicate reads its argument and compiled constants only.
+
+class Columns:
+	extends RefCounted
+	## One cold image of owner 8's sixteen i32 motion columns, in canonical schema order.
+	##
+	## Constructed with no arguments and no collaborator, so a saved image can be checked before
+	## anything is bound. Defaults are zero except the two cell columns, whose null value is
+	## NO_REQUEST and not cell 0.
+
+	var vx: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var vz: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var remainder_x: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var remainder_z: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var next_x: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var next_z: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var correction_x: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var correction_z: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var radius_u: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var desired_yaw: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var next_yaw: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var grid_next: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var grid_cell: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var speed_u_per_s: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var movement_phase: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var blocked_ticks: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		"""Size all sixteen columns to MOTION_CAPACITY and apply owner 8's documented defaults."""
+		vx.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		vz.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		remainder_x.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		remainder_z.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		next_x.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		next_z.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		correction_x.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		correction_z.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		radius_u.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		desired_yaw.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		next_yaw.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		grid_next.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		grid_cell.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		speed_u_per_s.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		movement_phase.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		blocked_ticks.resize(MOTION_CAPACITY)
+		grid_next.fill(NO_REQUEST)
+		grid_cell.fill(NO_REQUEST)
+
+	func is_sized() -> bool:
+		"""True only when every column holds exactly MOTION_CAPACITY rows."""
+		return vx.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY and vz.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY \
+			and remainder_x.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY and remainder_z.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY \
+			and next_x.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY and next_z.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY \
+			and correction_x.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY and correction_z.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY \
+			and radius_u.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY and desired_yaw.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY \
+			and next_yaw.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY and grid_next.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY \
+			and grid_cell.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY and speed_u_per_s.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY \
+			and movement_phase.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY and blocked_ticks.size() == MOTION_CAPACITY
+
+
+static func columns_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""The first owner-8 domain violation in a cold column image, or REFUSE_NONE.
+
+	SHAPE IS CHECKED BEFORE ANY INDEX. A null image, or any column that is not exactly
+	MOTION_CAPACITY long, answers REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE without reading a row, so a short image
+	cannot be indexed out of range on the way to a more specific code.
+
+	Rows are then examined in ascending physical order and the first refusal wins, so a refusal
+	names the lowest offending row's highest-priority gate. Nothing anywhere is written.
+	"""
+	if image == null or not image.is_sized():
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE
+	for row: int in MOTION_CAPACITY:
+		var refusal: StringName = _column_row_refusal(image, row)
+		if refusal != REFUSE_NONE:
+			return refusal
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _column_row_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""One row's gates in the contract's exact priority: phase, reserved, remainder, speed,
+	velocity, cell, target, then the phase relations."""
+	var phase: int = image.movement_phase[row]
+	if phase < MOTION_IDLE or phase >= MOTION_PHASE_COUNT:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_PHASE
+	if not _columns_reserved_clear(image, row):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_RESERVED
+	if not _is_remainder(image.remainder_x[row]) or not _is_remainder(image.remainder_z[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_REMAINDER
+	var speed: int = image.speed_u_per_s[row]
+	if speed != 0 and ResidentsScript.SIZE_MOVEMENT_U_PER_S.find(speed) < 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_SPEED
+	var limit: int = (speed + TICKS_PER_SECOND - 1) / TICKS_PER_SECOND
+	if not _is_within(image.vx[row], limit) or not _is_within(image.vz[row], limit):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_VELOCITY
+	if not _is_cell(image.grid_cell[row]) or not _is_cell(image.grid_next[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_CELL
+	if not _is_target_pair(image.next_x[row], image.next_z[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_TARGET
+	return _columns_state_refusal(image, row)
+
+
+static func _columns_reserved_clear(image: Columns, row: int) -> bool:
+	"""True when all six columns the current producer never writes are exactly zero.
+
+	They are RESERVED, not a licence to infer geometry or facing: `correction_*` awaits the
+	separation pass, `radius_u` a body-plus-gear envelope, the two yaws a stated zero reference,
+	and `blocked_ticks` has no producer in this slice."""
+	return image.correction_x[row] == 0 and image.correction_z[row] == 0 \
+		and image.radius_u[row] == 0 and image.desired_yaw[row] == 0 \
+		and image.next_yaw[row] == 0 and image.blocked_ticks[row] == 0
+
+
+static func _is_remainder(value: int) -> bool:
+	"""True for 0..REMAINDER_DENOMINATOR-1, the retained fraction's only legal domain."""
+	return value >= 0 and value < REMAINDER_DENOMINATOR
+
+
+static func _is_within(value: int, limit: int) -> bool:
+	"""True when `-limit <= value <= limit`. Two-sided: reverse travel is negative, not invalid."""
+	return value >= -limit and value <= limit
+
+
+static func _is_cell(cell: int) -> bool:
+	"""True for NO_REQUEST or a cell inside `spatial_world.gd`'s 0..CELL_COUNT-1 domain."""
+	return cell == NO_REQUEST or (cell >= 0 and cell < SpatialWorld.CELL_COUNT)
+
+
+static func _is_centre_coordinate(units: int) -> bool:
+	"""True when one axis of a stored target is an exact cell centre in 1/1024 m units.
+
+	One helper serves both axes because CELLS_X and CELLS_Z are equal; the bound is read from
+	those constants rather than written as 261888, so a resized map cannot leave it behind."""
+	if units < SpatialWorld.CELL_CENTRE_OFFSET_UNITS:
+		return false
+	if units > (SpatialWorld.CELLS_X - 1) * SpatialWorld.CELL_SIZE_UNITS \
+			+ SpatialWorld.CELL_CENTRE_OFFSET_UNITS:
+		return false
+	return (units - SpatialWorld.CELL_CENTRE_OFFSET_UNITS) % SpatialWorld.CELL_SIZE_UNITS == 0
+
+
+static func _is_target_pair(x_units: int, z_units: int) -> bool:
+	"""Both zero (no stored waypoint) or both exact cell centres. A mixed pair is invalid."""
+	if x_units == 0 and z_units == 0:
+		return true
+	return _is_centre_coordinate(x_units) and _is_centre_coordinate(z_units)
+
+
+static func _columns_state_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""The phase relations, reached only once every standalone domain above holds.
+
+	Terminal rows RETAIN history: ARRIVED keeps its final bounded displacement and may hold a
+	zero target after a one-cell route, and phases 3..5 keep their fractions and abandoned
+	target while carrying no velocity. IDLE keeps its valid speed and grid cell."""
+	var phase: int = image.movement_phase[row]
+	if phase == MOTION_IDLE:
+		return _columns_idle_refusal(image, row)
+	if phase == MOTION_TRAVELLING:
+		return _columns_travelling_refusal(image, row)
+	if image.speed_u_per_s[row] <= 0 or image.grid_cell[row] < 0 \
+			or image.grid_next[row] != NO_REQUEST:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	if phase == MOTION_ARRIVED:
+		return _columns_arrived_refusal(image, row)
+	if image.vx[row] != 0 or image.vz[row] != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_idle_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""IDLE carries no motion at all, and is not normalized any further.
+
+	Velocity, both remainders and both target coordinates are zero and no next cell is held. A
+	valid speed and a grid cell are RETAINED history, so a parked or reused row is not rewritten
+	by this validator."""
+	if image.vx[row] != 0 or image.vz[row] != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	if image.remainder_x[row] != 0 or image.remainder_z[row] != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	if image.next_x[row] != 0 or image.next_z[row] != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	if image.grid_next[row] != NO_REQUEST:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_travelling_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""TRAVELLING holds a positive speed, both cells, and the exact centre of `grid_next`.
+
+	Zero instantaneous velocity is legal before the row's first tick, and the remainders keep
+	their fractional domain, so neither is constrained further here."""
+	if image.speed_u_per_s[row] <= 0 or image.grid_cell[row] < 0 or image.grid_next[row] < 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	return _columns_target_is_centre(image, row, image.grid_next[row])
+
+
+static func _columns_arrived_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""ARRIVED keeps its bounded final velocity, and may hold no target at all.
+
+	An all-zero target is how a public one-cell route that arrives during admission reads; any
+	other target must be exactly the centre of the cell the body is standing in."""
+	if image.next_x[row] == 0 and image.next_z[row] == 0:
+		return REFUSE_NONE
+	return _columns_target_is_centre(image, row, image.grid_cell[row])
+
+
+static func _columns_target_is_centre(image: Columns, row: int, cell: int) -> StringName:
+	"""REFUSE_NONE when the stored target is exactly `cell`'s centre, else REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE.
+
+	`spatial_world.gd`'s static centre helpers are reused rather than re-derived, and only after
+	the cell-domain gate has accepted `cell`, so neither is ever called on a sentinel."""
+	if image.next_x[row] != SpatialWorld.cell_centre_x_units(cell):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	if image.next_z[row] != SpatialWorld.cell_centre_z_units(cell):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
